name: type: ✨ feature
description: New capability or enhancement

name: type: 🐛 bugfix
description: Something works incorrectly and needs fixing

name: type: ♻️ refactor
description: Code restructuring with no change in behaviour

name: type: ⚡ perf
description: Performance or resource usage improvement

name: type: 📚 docs
description: Documentation, README, code comments

name: type: 🔧 chore
description: Maintenance: deps, config, build, housekeeping

name: type: 🧪 test
description: Adding or improving tests, no behaviour change

name: type: 🔍 spike
description: Research or investigation — output is a decision, not code

name: type: 🔒 security
description: Hardening, permissions, sandboxing, secret handling

name: prio: P0-critical
description: Broken for everyone or data at risk — drop everything

name: prio: P1-high
description: Important, blocks the current milestone

name: prio: P2-medium
description: Should be done, but can wait for a free slot

name: prio: P3-low
description: Nice to have, no deadline

name: meta: ❓ needs triage
description: Newly opened — not yet typed, sized or prioritised

name: meta: 💥 breaking change
description: Breaks an existing tool contract or workflow

name: meta: 🚧 blocked
description: Waiting on an external dependency, decision or another issue

name: meta: ♊ duplicate
description: Already tracked in another issue

name: meta: 💬 needs discussion
description: Requires a decision before any code is written

name: meta: 🗑️ wontfix
description: Valid, but intentionally will not be worked on

name: area: git
